mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) is associated with positive 20-day S&P 500 returns, as lower interest rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, increasing equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 for mean return >0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) with monthly growth exceeding 0.3% for three consecutive months signals high inflation, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as central banks tighten monetary policy.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly growth > 0.3% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly growth > 0.3% for 3 consecutive months (t-test p>0.05 for mean return <0).

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer demand, indicated by housing starts (HOUST) above 780.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 350000.0, leads to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings growth is supported.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 780.0 and RSAFS > 350000.0 (t-test p>0.05 for mean return >0).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) exceeds 6.5%, it signals economic weakness, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as corporate earnings growth is expected to slow.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 6.5% (t-test p>0.05 for mean return <0).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) is associated with positive 5-day S&P 500 returns, as rising housing activity signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 780.0 (t-test p>0.05 for mean return >0).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns as recession fears increase.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0 (t-test p>0.05 for mean return <0).

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is high (above 215.0) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is low (below 0.5%), it indicates a stagflation risk, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as central banks are constrained from easing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 for mean return <0).

mechanism_narrative: In high interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations and economic growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% (t-test p>0.05 for mean return <0).
